n: <int> Number of items available for selection.
capacity: <int> Maximum total weight the knapsack can carry.
weights: <list[int], length n> Weight of each item.
profit_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [n][n]> Symmetric matrix where the diagonal entry for an item is its standalone profit and each off-diagonal entry for a pair of items is the additional interaction profit earned when both items are selected together.
